scripts.run:all: pnpm kill:ports && concurrently -k -n server,ui,website,mobile -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "pnpm -C app/server dev" "pnpm -C app/ui dev" "pnpm -C website dev" "pnpm -C app/mobile start"
scripts.dev:web: pnpm kill:ports && concurrently -k -n server,ui,website -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm -C app/server dev" "pnpm -C app/ui dev" "pnpm -C website dev"
scripts.install:all: pnpm -C app/server install && pnpm -C app/ui install && pnpm -C website install && pnpm -C app/mobile install
scripts.update:all: pnpm -C app/server update --latest && pnpm -C app/ui update --latest && pnpm -C website update --latest && pnpm -C app/mobile update --latest
scripts.build:all: pnpm -C app/server build && pnpm -C app/ui build && pnpm -C website build
scripts.lint:all: concurrently -n server,ui,mobile "pnpm -C app/server lint" "pnpm -C app/ui lint" "pnpm -C app/mobile lint"
scripts.test:all: concurrently -n server,mobile "pnpm -C app/server test" "pnpm -C app/mobile test"
